purpose: Paperclip native state and Hermes MiniMax binding persistence canary after byte-identical safe_restart from paperclip-runtime.lock.json. Side-effect-free; auto-mode lane cannot execute safe_restart or capture pre/post snapshots without operator confirmation.
phase_verdict_rationale: Auto-mode lane cannot execute paperclip-runtime.lock.json safe_restart_command (LFP-LF-02 + LFP-S02-02 require operator confirmation and byte-identical command from lockfile only). Pre/post snapshots of 8 native/runtime surfaces (companies, agents, memberships, plugins, postgres_data_path, hermes_agent_version, hermes_providers_profile, hermes_active_profile) are PLAN-only; live capture is gated on operator-confirmed safe_restart execution. Persistence verdict will be promoted to PASS only when all 8 pre/post sha256 pairs are equal AND hermes_providers_profile post-restart still references minimax/MiniMax-M3 (no xiaomi re-emergence).
live_execution_status_rationale: operator-confirmed D062 proof: controlled server restart with byte-equivalent DB/version/image snapshots
fresh_readback_via: authenticated SSH tunnel plus direct Postgres identity readback on the canonical VPS

diff_policy.rule: For every snapshot target, pre_restart_snapshot[target].sha256 MUST equal post_restart_snapshot[target].sha256.
diff_policy.hermes_binding_extra: hermes_providers_profile MUST show provider=minimax and model=MiniMax-M3 in BOTH pre and post (i.e. canonical MiniMax profile survives safe_restart, xiaomi does NOT come back)

promotion_discipline.policy: PASS verdict requires (a) all 8 pre/post snapshot target sha256 pairs equal, (b) hermes_providers_profile post-restart still references minimax provider AND MiniMax-M3 model, (c) safe_restart_command_sha256 matches paperclip-runtime.lock.json SHA-256 byte-for-byte (no command extension), (d) no credential value or unapproved UUID literal in snapshot captures (V-PRST-11 + V-PRST-12).

fail_closed_postures.FAIL_SAFE_RESTART_COMMAND_MUTATED: safe_restart_command_sha256 differs from paperclip-runtime.lock.json; command was extended or substituted (LFP-S02-02 breach)
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_NATIVE_STATE_DRIFT: any of paperclip_companies/agents/memberships/plugins sha256 differs; entity loss or duplication
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_HERMES_BINDING_DRIFT: hermes_providers_profile post-restart no longer references minimax OR no longer references MiniMax-M3
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_PG_DATA_PATH_MISSING: paperclip_postgres_data_path.sha256 differs OR cannot be computed (data volume missing or unwritable)
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_PRE_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: pre_restart_snapshot missing or captured_at_utc not within 5 minutes of safe_restart invocation
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_POST_SNAPSHOT_MISSING: post_restart_snapshot missing or captured_at_utc not within 5 minutes of paperclip_back_up_signal
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_CREDENTIAL_LEAK: snapshot capture contains credential value or unapproved UUID literal (V-PRST-11 + V-PRST-12 fail)
fail_closed_postures.FAIL_TERMINAL_NONZERO_EXIT: safe_restart_command exits non-zero OR post-restart paperclip_healthcheck fails
